newsitem.title: JAPAN: OSE TO EXTEND TRADING HOURS BY 10 MINS, CUT FEES.
newsitem.headline: OSE TO EXTEND TRADING HOURS BY 10 MINS, CUT FEES.

text.p: The Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) said on Friday it would extend floor-trading hours by 10 minutes until 3.10 p.m. (0610 GMT), beginning on September 1.
The Osaka bourse also said it would concurrently halve some membership fees and commissions for large-lot cross trades.
The changes were adopted in response to the "Big Bang" financial reforms being pursued by the Japanese government, the Osaka bourse said in a statement.
It said the extention of trading hours was aimed at boosting trading activity.
The halving of fees and commissions for large-lot cross trades worth more than one billion yen is aimed at attracting business to the bourse.
